title: The social-class gap in negotiation: Lower-class individuals negotiate less and face more backlash.
summary: Economic inequality has widened considerably in the United States and globally, raising pressing questions about the mechanisms that reproduce social stratification. One prominent manifestation of this inequality is the "class ceiling" in organizations: individuals from lower social classes earn less and advance more slowly than their higher-class counterparts, even with comparable credentials. We identify a crucial behavioral pathway contributing to this class ceiling: a social-class gap in the propensity to negotiate. We propose that lower-class individuals are less likely to initiate negotiations than their higher-class counterparts, a pattern that can compound economic disadvantage over time. Across four studies (total N = 10,211)-including a nationally representative sample of employees (Study 1), a sample of business school students (Study 2), a field study of an online labor market (Study 3), and a survey study of workplace negotiations and career outcomes (Study 4)-we find consistent evidence for this gap. This gap is partially explained by lower-class individuals' reduced sense of power and heightened concerns about social backlash. Additionally, Study 5 (N = 1,133) finds that such concerns may be justified: an experiment with human resources (HR) professionals shows that identical negotiation requests elicit stronger social backlash when initiated by lower-class (vs. higher-class) individuals. Together, these findings reveal a pernicious double bind for lower-class individuals: remaining silent perpetuates economic disadvantage, yet initiating negotiation exposes them to greater social penalties. Addressing this double bind is critical for ensuring that negotiation serves as a vehicle for upward mobility rather than a gatekeeper of privilege.

标题：谈判中的社会阶层差距：低社会阶层个体谈判更少且面临更多社会反冲
摘要：经济不平等在美国及全球范围内显著加剧，引发了关于社会阶层再生产机制的关键问题。这种不平等的一个显著表现是组织中的“阶级天花板”：即使资历相当，来自低社会阶层的个体也比高社会阶层个体收入更低、晋升更慢。我们识别出导致这一阶级天花板的一个关键行为路径：谈判倾向中的社会阶层差距。我们提出，低社会阶层个体比高社会阶层个体更不可能主动发起谈判，这一模式会随时间加剧经济劣势。通过四项研究（总样本量N=10,211）——包括一项全国代表性员工样本（研究1）、一项商学院学生样本（研究2）、一项在线劳动力市场的实地研究（研究3）以及一项关于工作场合谈判与职业成果的调查研究（研究4）——我们一致发现了这一差距的证据。该差距部分由低社会阶层个体权力感降低和对社会反冲的高度担忧所解释。此外，研究5（N=1,133）发现这些担忧可能是合理的：一项针对人力资源专业人员的实验表明，当谈判请求由低社会阶层（相对于高社会阶层）个体发起时，会引发更强的社会反冲。综上所述，这些发现揭示了低社会阶层个体面临的一种恶性双重困境：保持沉默会延续经济劣势，而主动谈判则使他们面临更大的社会惩罚。解决这一双重困境对于确保谈判成为向上流动的工具而非特权的守门人至关重要。
关键词：社会阶层；谈判；社会反冲；权力感；经济不平等

title: Wireless, skin-attachable patch with 3D liquid metal electrodes for vagus nerve stimulation in depression.
summary: Current nonsurgical vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) approaches often suffer from broad current spread, high electrode-skin impedance, and unintended stimulation of surrounding tissues, which can reduce efficacy and cause side effects. Here, we present a wirelessly operable, skin-attachable VNS patch with three-dimensional liquid-metal electrodes that mimic the low modulus of biological tissues, developed as a minimally invasive platform for investigating the biological mechanisms underlying VNS in a mouse model of depression. The soft, low-modulus three-dimensional liquid metal electrodes gently penetrate the skin, bypass the stratum corneum, and improve electrode-tissue coupling while minimizing tissue damage compared with conventional planar or rigid electrodes. To comprehensively assess therapeutic effects, we conducted behavioral tests, neural probe-based brain signal analysis, dendritic spine density measurements, and blood and inguinal lymph node profiling in depression model mice. VNS increased plasma serotonin levels and increased dendritic spine density, indicating improved neuroplasticity. Corticosterone-induced depressive mice exhibited elevated CD4+ and B220+ cells, which normalized with VNS. These results establish an animal-level proof-of-concept that minimally invasive VNS can engage key neural and immunological pathways relevant to depression, providing a foundation for future neuromodulation strategies.

相关性：是
标题：具有3D液态金属电极的无线皮肤贴片用于抑郁症迷走神经刺激
摘要：当前的非手术迷走神经刺激方法常常受到电流扩散范围广、电极-皮肤阻抗高以及对周围组织产生非预期刺激等问题的困扰，这会降低疗效并引起副作用。本文提出了一种可无线操作的皮肤贴片式迷走神经刺激装置，采用三维液态金属电极模拟生物组织的低模量特性，作为微创平台研究抑郁症小鼠模型中迷走神经刺激的生物学机制。与传统平面或刚性电极相比，这种柔软、低模量的三维液态金属电极能轻柔地穿透皮肤，绕过角质层，改善电极-组织耦合，同时最小化组织损伤。为全面评估治疗效果，我们在抑郁症模型小鼠中进行了行为测试、基于神经探针的脑信号分析、树突棘密度测量以及血液和腹股沟淋巴结分析。迷走神经刺激增加了血浆血清素水平并提高了树突棘密度，表明神经可塑性得到改善。皮质酮诱导的抑郁小鼠表现出CD4+和B220+细胞升高，迷走神经刺激使其恢复正常。这些结果建立了动物层面的概念验证，表明微创迷走神经刺激能够激活与抑郁症相关的关键神经和免疫通路，为未来的神经调控策略奠定了基础。
关键词：迷走神经刺激；抑郁症；液态金属电极；神经可塑性；免疫调节

title: Emotion-BIND for multimodal emotion recognition and reasoning.
summary: Constructing Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation (MERC) models is important for understanding affective states from text, audio, images, and video. Existing approaches often rely on linear layers for cross-modal feature alignment and freeze encoder parameters during training, which can introduce feature degradation and modality misalignment. Conventional one-dimensional positional encoding is also limited when modeling visual and temporal information. To address these issues, this study presents Emotion-BIND, a multimodal framework that integrates ImageBind-based representations with a differentiated positional encoding strategy, termed m-ROPE. The framework maps features from multiple modalities into a shared embedding space and applies 2D RoPE to image representations and 3D RoPE to video representations, supporting multimodal spatial and temporal modeling. Experimental results show that Emotion-BIND achieves an Unweighted Average Recall (UAR) of 49.44%, a Weighted Average Recall (WAR) of 71.00%, and an F1 score of 90.05% on the DFEW dataset, with the highest WAR and F1 score among the compared methods, although its UAR remains lower than the best comparison model. On the MELD dataset, Emotion-BIND achieves a UAR of 55.67%, a WAR of 67.88%, and an F1 score of 91.02%. The source code is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21186484 and is also available on GitHub at https://github.com/qunlitang/Emotion-BIND.
translation:
相关性：是
标题：Emotion-BIND：面向多模态情绪识别与推理的框架
摘要：构建对话中的多模态情绪识别（MERC）模型对于理解来自文本、音频、图像和视频的情感状态至关重要。现有方法通常依赖线性层进行跨模态特征对齐，并在训练期间冻结编码器参数，这可能导致特征退化与模态不匹配。传统的一维位置编码在建模视觉和时间信息时也存在局限性。为解决这些问题，本研究提出了Emotion-BIND，一种集成基于ImageBind的表示与差异化位置编码策略（称为m-ROPE）的多模态框架。该框架将来自多种模态的特征映射到共享嵌入空间，并对图像表示应用2D RoPE、对视频表示应用3D RoPE，从而支持多模态空间和时间建模。实验结果表明，Emotion-BIND在DFEW数据集上实现了49.44%的非加权平均召回率（UAR）、71.00%的加权平均召回率（WAR）和90.05%的F1分数，其中WAR和F1分数在所比较方法中最高，尽管其UAR略低于最佳对比模型。在MELD数据集上，Emotion-BIND达到了55.67%的UAR、67.88%的WAR和91.02%的F1分数。源代码已存档于https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21186484，并可在GitHub上获取：https://github.com/qunlitang/Emotion-BIND。
关键词：多模态情绪识别；情感计算；跨模态对齐；位置编码；深度学习

title: Functional connectome of interpersonal trust and its role in the relationship between interpersonal trust and happiness.
summary: Interpersonal trust (IT) is a trait-based characteristic that refers to the general tendency for someone to trust others, serving as a fundamental component of social interactions with profound implications for well-being. While prior research has consistently established a positive association between IT and happiness, the neural correlates of this relationship remain poorly understood. To address this gap, I employed connectome-based predictive modeling (CPM) to analyze resting-state functional connectivity patterns in a large sample of healthy college students. The results revealed two key neural signatures: (1) a positive network characterized by connections between the salience network (SAN) and medial frontal regions (MF), and (2) a negative network comprising intra-SAN connections and links between the default mode network (DMN) and other networks (e.g., SAN, MF). These findings suggest that IT formation engages integrated affective, cognitive, and social cognitive processes. Moreover, the IT-happiness association was mediated by the strength of the positive network, hinting enhanced social support processing and cognitive control as potential neural mechanisms. This study provides novel suggestions about the neural correlates of IT and hints at how IT might be linked to happiness via brain networks interaction.
translation:
相关性：是
标题：人际信任的功能连接组及其在人际信任与幸福感关系中的作用
摘要：人际信任（IT）是一种基于特质的特征，指个体信任他人的一般倾向，作为社会互动的基本组成部分，对幸福感具有深远影响。虽然先前研究已一致证实IT与幸福感之间存在正相关，但这种关系的神经关联仍知之甚少。为填补这一空白，本研究采用基于连接组的预测建模（CPM），分析了一大批健康大学生的静息态功能连接模式。结果揭示了两个关键神经特征：（1）一个正性网络，其特征在于显著性网络（SAN）与内侧额叶区域（MF）之间的连接；（2）一个负性网络，包含SAN内部连接以及默认模式网络（DMN）与其他网络（如SAN、MF）之间的连接。这些发现表明，IT的形成涉及整合的情感、认知和社会认知过程。此外，IT与幸福感之间的关系由正性网络的强度中介，提示增强的社会支持处理和认知控制可能是潜在的神经机制。本研究为IT的神经关联提供了新的见解，并揭示了IT可能通过大脑网络相互作用与幸福感相关联的方式。
关键词：人际信任；幸福感；功能连接组；静息态功能连接；社会认知

title: Stuck on you! Social brain stimulation increases the cognitive effort required to return to the egocentric perspective.
summary: Flexible switching between self and other perspectives is critical for adaptive social cognition and is thought to rely on the dynamic regulation of self-other representations. Although neuroimaging implicates the dorsomedial prefrontal cortex (dmPFC) and right temporoparietal junction (rTPJ) in perspective-taking, causal evidence for their contributions to perspective switching is lacking. Here, we applied focal transcranial direct current stimulation (f-tDCS) to the dmPFC and rTPJ while participants completed a visual perspective-taking task requiring switches between egocentric and altercentric viewpoints. Anodal stimulation to either site selectively increased the cognitive cost of switching back to the egocentric-perspective, without affecting switches into the altercentric-perspective. Rather than facilitating re-engagement with self-referential processing, stimulation enhanced altercentric persistence or impaired disengagement from the altercentric perspective. These findings provide novel causal evidence that both the dmPFC and rTPJ are involved in regulating the inhibition and updating of self-other representations during perspective switching. Results suggest that stimulation of these hubs may disrupt efficient realignment to the self, highlighting their role in maintaining an altercentric cognitive state. Future studies are required to uncover the precise neural computations that account for the comparable behavioural outcomes observed across distinct social brain hubs.

相关性：是  
标题：迷上你了！社会脑刺激增加返回到自我中心视角所需的认知努力  
摘要：自我与他人视角之间的灵活切换对于适应性社会认知至关重要，并被认为依赖于自我-他人表征的动态调控。尽管神经影像学研究表明背内侧前额叶皮层（dmPFC）和右侧颞顶联合区（rTPJ）参与视角采择，但关于它们对视角切换贡献的因果证据仍然缺乏。本研究在参与者完成一项要求从自我中心视角和他者中心视角间切换的视觉视角采择任务时，对dmPFC和rTPJ施加聚焦经颅直流电刺激（f-tDCS）。结果表明，对任一脑区的阳极刺激选择性地增加了返回到自我中心视角的认知成本，而不影响切换到他人中心视角的过程。刺激并未促进自我参照加工的重新参与，而是增强了他者中心视角的持续存在，或损害了从他者中心视角的脱离。这些发现提供了新的因果证据，表明dmPFC和rTPJ在视角切换过程中参与调节自我-他人表征的抑制和更新。结果提示，这些社会脑枢纽的刺激可能破坏了向自我有效重新对齐的过程，突出了它们在维持他者中心认知状态中的作用。未来研究需揭示解释不同社会脑枢纽中观察到的类似行为结果背后的神经计算机制。  
关键词：视角采择；自我-他人表征；背内侧前额叶皮层；右侧颞顶联合区；经颅直流电刺激

title: Resting-state functional connectivity correlates of emotional memory control under cognitive load in subclinical anxiety.
summary: Volitional memory control supports adaptive cognition by enabling intentional Suppression of goal-irrelevant, interfering memories and Recall of goal-relevant memories. Neural mechanisms of Suppression and Recall have been studied largely in isolation, and their operation under concurrent working memory load in the context of subclinical anxiety remains unclear. We examined the control of emotionally valenced memories in 47 healthy participants with varying levels of subclinical anxiety under dual-task conditions, involving directed Suppression and Recall while concurrently performing a secondary task that imposed a visual working memory load. Cognitive efficiency in controlling dual-task memory-linked interference, measured by the Balanced Integration Score (BIS), showed no differences between Suppression vs. Recall; across emotions or influence from anxiety. Intrinsic functional brain networks measured by seed-to-voxel resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) revealed dissociable rsFC profiles linked to Cognitive Control across emotional valences, and these relationships were moderated by anxiety. Efficient Suppression of positive memories correlated with reduced connectivity between anterior cingulate cortex and posterior perceptual-midline regions, and diminished hippocampal-frontal pole coupling. Conversely, efficient Suppression of negative memories correlated with increased posterior parietal - lateral occipital regional connectivity. Anxiety particularly moderated associations between Cognitive Control and prefrontal connectivity during Suppression of positive memories and Recall of positive and neutral memories. Direct comparisons further revealed stronger hippocampal-thalamic rsFC during Suppression vs. Recall of positive memories. Together, we delineate the neural correlates of volitional emotional memory control under cognitive load and suggest that subclinical anxiety severity shapes these networks selectively, providing targets for future mechanistic studies.

相关性：是  
标题：亚临床焦虑中认知负荷下的情绪记忆控制的静息态功能连接相关研究  
摘要：自主记忆控制通过支持有意识地对与目标无关的干扰性记忆进行抑制（Suppression）以及对目标相关记忆进行回忆（Recall），从而促进适应性认知。目前，抑制与回忆的神经机制大多被孤立研究，而在亚临床焦虑背景下，这些过程在并行的认知工作记忆负荷条件下的运作机制尚不明确。本研究对47名健康参与者（具有不同程度的亚临床焦虑水平）在双任务条件下对情绪效价记忆的控制进行了考察：参与者需在完成一项施加视觉工作记忆负荷的次要任务的同时，进行定向抑制与回忆。通过平衡整合分数（Balanced Integration Score）测量的双任务记忆相关干扰的认知效率显示，抑制与回忆之间、不同情绪之间以及焦虑的影响方面均无显著差异。通过种子点至体素的静息态功能连接（rsFC）测量的内在功能脑网络揭示了与不同情绪效价下的认知控制相关的可分离的rsFC模式，且这些关系受到焦虑的调节。对正性记忆的高效抑制与前后扣带回至后部感知-中线区域连接性的降低以及海马-前额叶皮层耦合的减弱相关；而对负性记忆的高效抑制则与后顶叶-外侧枕叶区域连接性的增强相关。焦虑尤其调节了正性记忆抑制以及正性与中性记忆回忆过程中认知控制与前额叶连接性的关联。直接比较还发现，在正性记忆抑制相对于回忆过程中，海马-丘脑的rsFC更强。综上，我们描绘了认知负荷下自主情绪记忆控制的神经相关因素，并提示亚临床焦虑严重程度选择性地塑造了这些网络，为未来的机制研究提供了靶点。  
关键词：情绪记忆控制；亚临床焦虑；静息态功能连接；认知负荷；双任务范式

title: Perceptual heterogeneity in developmental prosopagnosia: The role of the right OFA.
summary: Individuals with lifelong face recognition impairment, developmental prosopagnosia (DP), provide a unique testbed for understanding the neural mechanisms of face recognition. Although the right occipital face area (OFA) and right fusiform face area (FFA) are critical for face processing, studies examining their functionality in DP have been inconclusive. Two barriers that have prevented the development of a neural theory of DP are behavioural heterogeneity and limited sample sizes. Using one of the largest samples of DPs collected to examine OFA/FFA function, we tested whether face selectivity in the OFA and FFA relates to individual differences in perceptual impairment in 34 DPs. Face perception, measured using two face matching tasks, was significantly correlated with face selectivity in the right OFA and FFA in DPs. Then, using feature-specific tasks to measure perception of the eye and mouth regions separately, right OFA selectivity was found to be specific to perception of the eye region. The results are the first to connect the right OFA to eye perception deficits in DP, and one of the few studies to demonstrate the neural underpinnings of DP behavioural heterogeneity. More broadly, these findings support the view that the right OFA is specialized for extracting visual information from the eye region.
translation:
相关性：是
标题：发展性面孔失认症的感知异质性：右侧枕叶面孔区的作用
摘要：患有终身面孔识别障碍的发展性面孔失认症（DP）个体，为理解面孔识别的神经机制提供了独特的试验平台。尽管右侧枕叶面孔区（OFA）和右侧梭状回面孔区（FFA）在面孔加工中至关重要，但针对DP中这些区域功能的研究结论尚不明确。阻碍DP神经理论发展的两大障碍是行为异质性和样本量有限。本研究采用迄今最大样本量之一（34名DP患者），检验了OFA和FFA的面孔选择性是否与DP患者的感知障碍个体差异相关。结果显示，DP患者在两项面孔匹配任务中测得的面孔感知能力，与其右侧OFA和FFA的面孔选择性显著相关。进一步通过特征特异性任务分别测量眼睛和嘴巴区域的感知能力，发现右侧OFA的选择性特异性地与眼睛区域的感知相关。该结果首次将右侧OFA与DP患者的眼睛感知缺陷联系起来，也是少数揭示DP行为异质性神经基础的研究之一。更广泛而言，这些发现支持了右侧OFA专门负责从眼睛区域提取视觉信息的观点。
关键词：发展性面孔失认症；右侧枕叶面孔区；面孔感知；感知异质性；眼部区域
